title: Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit Program Supplement Schedule
content:
**Program supplement — Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit**

A program supplement applies to the Hometown Heroes award, read from the loan program on the borrower's Mortgage Loan File. It is added to the starting amount, before the award is raised to 500.00 when below it and lowered to the program's credit cap when above it.

| Loan program | Program supplement |
|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | adds 125.00 |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | adds 125.00 |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | adds 75.00 |
| any other program | adds nothing |

**Clause.** An FHA or VA file adds 125.00, a HomeReady file adds 75.00, and any other program adds nothing.
